entities.summary: Jan Sas Zubrzycki was a Polish architect known for his neo-Gothic designs and for developing the "Vistula style". His most notable work is the grand Governor's Palace in Lviv (1876). In 1920, he was appointed to the Board of the Union of Polish Scientific Societies, representing the Society for the Protection of Monuments of Art and Culture.
